means: The same kind of danbooru file metadata as absurdres, one band down - auto-applied at roughly 1600px on a side. Again a fact about the file, not about the picture.
does: The same detail-density push as absurdres but weaker, and largely redundant beside it: on the corpus every absurdres image is also a highres image, so the two overlap heavily and stacking both spends a token restating the first. This project standardised on absurdres and left highres out, which is the right call.
reach_for_it: as a SUBSTITUTE for absurdres when fine detail is coming back noisy or over-busy and you want a gentler nudge - not alongside it
used_in: nothing here - the standard block standardised on absurdres instead
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
